text:
Ava: Heads-up — shortlist for the next webinar abstracts. Thinking a hotseat panel + a single 10-min lightning demo. Need speaker confirmations and rehearsal slots this week. Quick thoughts?

Jon: Love the hotseat idea. Which abstracts are you considering?

Ava: Shortlist (top 3):
1) Cost-aware inference: real customer tradeoffs (conversion focus)
2) Serving distro: hosted → dedicated → private in the wild (enterprise story)
3) Benchmarks that matter: latency vs. quality tradeoffs for production

Priya: 1 and 3 convert best for inbound. 2 is great for enterprise pipeline but lower pull from self-serve leads. Maybe poll the audience during registration?

Marco: Infra can demo a tiny routing case study for #2. Demo would be a short Jupyter + live trace — 10 min works. Need to confirm quantization artefacts won't change the demo output.

Elena: @Marco can you commit to a rehearsal on Thu 2pm PT? We need at least one technical dry run.

Marco: Yes, Thu 2pm PT works. I'll bring the demo notebook and a fallback recording.

Ava: Speaker ask: 8–10 slides per speaker + 5 min live Q. Hotseat moderator needed — @Jon, can you run the panel?

Jon: I can moderate. Will prep 5 moderator prompts and handle audience q. Can you drop a short prep doc?

Ava: I'll draft a prep doc with run sheet, moderator prompts, and fallback plan. Will include talking points for conversions + CTA.

Sam: Design will create a 3-slide template (title, 1-2 metric slides, CTA) and a sponsor/end slate. Need speaker headshots by Mon EOD.

webhook-bot: Reminder: book studio 30m before show — /book studio 2026-04-02 09:30 PT

Priya: Poll ideas: 1) Primary pain (cost / latency / reliability) 2) Deployment mode (hosted / dedicated / private). Want to capture these as lead tags for follow-up.

Ava: Quick run snippet for the doc (rough):

```
09:00 PT — green room opens (mic check + presentation load)
09:25 PT — presenters in staging; last mic checks
09:30 PT — webinar live: intro (Ava, 3m)
09:33 PT — lightning demo (Marco, 10m)
09:44 PT — hotseat panel (Jon moderates, 25m)
10:09 PT — live poll + CTA (Priya, 5m)
10:14 PT — closing + next steps (Ava, 1m)
10:15 PT — session ends / recording saved
```

Elena: Pre-show checklist I'll own: mic check, demo tokens, fallback video, HSM/KMS confirmation for any customer data, and a contact for infra support.

Ava: OK — action items:
- Marco: confirm demo recording + Thu 2pm rehearsal
- Speakers: headshots to Sam by Mon EOD
- Jon: moderator prompts by Tue
- Priya: poll + lead tagging flow by Wed
- Elena: pre-show checklist and studio booking confirmation

Jon: Sounds good. I'll draft moderator prompts and ping speakers for timing.

Priya: I'll wire the poll into the registration flow and share a tag mapping doc.

Ava: Great — I'll circulate the prep doc today and create a calendar invite for Thu rehearsal. :rocket:

Elena: Confirmed — calendar incoming and I'll attach the checklist.

Sam: Will design slides once headshots arrive.

Ava: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the prep doc is out.
